description: This is an abstract class defining a cache interface with common properties and methods for cache management and statistics. It includes properties for local store, external cache interactions, and cache statistics, along with abstract methods for subclasses to implement specific external cache logic.

classes.name: SugarCacheAbstract
classes.description: An abstract class providing a common interface and shared logic for cache implementations, including methods for getting, setting, resetting, and gathering statistics about the cache.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes cache timeout and key prefix from global configuration.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Retrieves value from the cache, checking local store first if enabled.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with optional TTL.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the cache.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Removes a key from the cache.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the local cache store for the current request.

methods.name: resetFull
methods.description: Resets both local and external caches.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears all cache data locally and externally.

methods.name: getCacheStats
methods.description: Returns statistics about cache hits, misses, and requests.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the cache backend type as a lowercase string.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Abstract method for setting a value in the external cache.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Abstract method for retrieving a value from the external cache.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Abstract method for clearing a value from the external cache.

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: Abstract method for resetting the external cache.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if the cache backend should be used based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority level for cache backend usage.
